title: allow the UI role to run `go -C WORKTREE run ./cmd/ork help` (read-only, prints to stdout) so it can render CLI output with the project's own binary

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-150234-f362, project ork, item S346:

allow the UI role to run `go -C WORKTREE run ./cmd/ork help` (read-only, prints to stdout) so it can render CLI output with the project's own binary

Evidence: go run ./cmd/ork help was denied with "This command requires approval"; the usage render had to be copied by hand from the constant
